create_ComputeSqrt: create a ComputeSqrt task instance that generates binary square root training data
sample_batch_ComputeSqrt: sample a batch of binary numbers and their floor square roots using ComputeSqrt
get_input_size_ComputeSqrt: get the input size property of a ComputeSqrt task which returns 2
get_output_size_ComputeSqrt: get the output size property of a ComputeSqrt task which returns 2
compute_output_length: compute the output length for a given input length using ceil(input_length / 2)
